reasoning: 18.3.1（APP3.1）規定此容器的指示器文字為 "Presets Shown"。這是容器分界在字串層級的直接體現：同一個指示器在 Browse Presets List 依 PRE2.3.5 顯示 "Number of Presets Shown"（RAD-060），兩者差兩個字，跨容器複製貼上即為現成的假通過。故 ER 不只要求本容器的正確版本，還明確排除另一個容器的版本，使「複製錯字串」這種失效無法通過。容器錨定：ch18 內有兩個彈窗容器——Presets Pop-up 與其上 Edit Presets 按鈕開啟的 Edit Presets Pop-up（APP12）。加上 ch17 的 Mixed Presets Bank 與 ch16 的 Browse Presets List，同一批 preset 共有四個容器，故每一行 ER 指名觀察所在的容器，且只引用該容器自己的字串。優先級：屬標籤文字，訂 P2。

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the text 'Presets Shown' for the indicator in the All Presets Pop-up.

(Indicator label inside the Presets Pop-up)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot holds a stored station
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Press the "All Presets" button on the Playing Tab
4. Read the text displayed with the Presets Shown indicator in the Presets Pop-up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The Presets Pop-up is displayed over the Media screen
4. The text displayed with the indicator in the Presets Pop-up is "Presets Shown" and is not "Number of Presets Shown"
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
